dialogues.speaker: Shakhovskaya
dialogues.text: Look at you, Praporshchik Rozhdestvensky. Your bearing is barely distinguishable from that of a dissolute sellsword. You are a Druzhna, Tsaritsa's sake.

dialogues.speaker: Rozhdestvensky
dialogues.text: Oh, come now, Your Grace. What would you have me do? Emulate some of our colleagues and strut in circles, dressed in my parade best, taking military theater for license to feign blindness to crime in this city?

dialogues.speaker: Rozhdestvensky
dialogues.text: If you want to catch the scum who skulk in the shadows and foment chaos, you're going to find yourself in dark, dank corners the higher-ups would never give a second look...

dialogues.speaker: Rozhdestvensky
dialogues.text: In which case, this outfit will serve far better than uniforms bedecked with medals.

dialogues.speaker: Shakhovskaya
dialogues.text: I can't believe you! Why, I'm starting to suspect you've never read a single page of the Druzhna drill manual!

dialogues.speaker: Shakhovskaya
dialogues.text: Solemn bearings, majestic formations, those are the blades by which we drive evil back, not by scurrying through the sewers like rats!

dialogues.speaker: Malinina
dialogues.text: Oh, come now, let's not get all worked up...

dialogues.speaker: Malinina
dialogues.text: A visit from Rozhdestvensky's hard come by, y'know? I've got freshly brewed tea and some snacks Lady Vesna sent us. Let's have ourselves a seat and a chat, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Rozhdestvensky
dialogues.text: Much appreciated, Miss Malinina, but I believe I shan't be staying here for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Shakhovskaya
dialogues.text: Running with your tail between your legs, are we? You see? That's what you get for abandoning honor and pride. Next thing I know, you're going to be as hopeless as those Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Rozhdestvensky
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. Are you quite done, dear lady? These lectures of yours never fail to magically transport me to solitary confinement in some cloistered school for noble daughters...

dialogues.speaker: Malinina
dialogues.text: Come now, Lady Shakhovskaya means well! I mean, where would our merry lot of disparate fae be without order and discipline?

dialogues.speaker: Malinina
dialogues.text: And she's saying this because she's concerned about you, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Shakhovskaya
dialogues.text: Concer— Yes, indeed. Of course. This is the duty that those at the top must take on, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Malinina
dialogues.text: See? There you have it. And I'm sure Her Ladyship will not protest so much, Rozhdestvensky, should you be willing to join us for evening exercises.

dialogues.speaker: Rozhdestvensky
dialogues.text: Okay, sure. Since you've been so generous, Miss Malinina, I suppose I'll have to dust off that outdated uniform of ours.
